sections.title: Kilometres and walking
sections.content: To say how far a place is, give a number and *kilométer*, then *innen*. After a number the noun stays singular: *A park egy kilométer innen.* *Az iskola három kilométer innen.* Ask *Hány kilométer?* Another new word: *gyalog* (on foot). *Gyalog megyek a bankba.* (I walk to the bank.)

items.english: The park is one kilometre from here.
The school is three kilometres from here.
How many kilometres is the hospital?

items.spanish: A bolt közel van, gyalog megyek.
items.english: The shop is near, I walk.

sections.content: Never *három kilométerek*: after a number *kilométer* stays singular.
